card.name: Words before cautioned actions or excess
card.fires_on: Small linking or intensifying words (to, too, excessive, following, before, with) placed right before a warned-against action or an over-the-top degree, in cautionary label text.

modes.label: Linking word before a warned action
modes.description: A word like to, before, following or with that leads into an instruction or a caution about what a patient does or receives.
modes.example: Instruct patients not<< to>> take products containing folic acid or fol

modes.label: Excess or too-much wording
modes.description: Words such as too, excessive or overzealous describing an overly strong effect or treatment.
modes.example: overdose are those caused by electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypochloremia, hyponatremia) and dehydration resulting from<< excessive>> diuresis.

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words about attempting or trying an action.
card.plain: It marks the small word just before a caution about doing something or doing too much.
